title: When Do Reusable Temporal Procedures Actually Repair Agents?

objections.r12_closure: The title, abstract, introduction, and related work center procedure-repair identification rather than skill-container novelty. Temporal retrieval and reusable-skill learning remain explicitly conceded prior art.

The canonical r9 zero-call audit remains intact: targeted/generic are forced once in 442/442 rows each, no-skill 0/442; condition-position p>.65 in every arm; targeted prompts average 18.85 input tokens shorter. R12 further limits these diagnostics to explanations of T-G rather than treating them as resource matching for T-N.

The canonical r10 ISO-date audit remains a reproducibility diagnostic: all serialized date fields are valid YYYY-MM-DD and 88/88 observed T1 lexical comparisons agree with parsed-calendar order. No new scientific result is inferred.

Still unexecuted. R12 now distinguishes the executed target-blind G from a prospective behavior-neutral G0 and explicitly states that N is the original agent, not a resource-matched neutral-helper arm. The G0 treatment semantics are frozen in a design-only reopen receipt, but no neutrality outcome exists.

Still unexecuted. R12 names operation-matched retrieval as the strongest same-information alternative for any container claim and defines a prospective T-R estimand. The manuscript explicitly limits current evidence to operation value under N/G/T.

Small endpoint cells, ceiling regimes, and the cross-domain grounding null remain visible in the main story. R12 further compresses transfer language to a conditional compatible/non-ceiling boundary and does not claim model-invariant or general cross-domain transfer.
Controlled helper exposure remains explicitly distinguished from endogenous skill selection; R12 continues to estimate forced procedure exposure rather than autonomous call propensity.

r12_material_improvements: operation value separated from implementation/container value
T-N correctly described as original-agent increment rather than equal-call control
G0 behavior-neutral helper explicitly separated from executed G
operation-matched retrieval R explicitly identified as the missing container-comparison treatment
prospective G0/R treatment semantics frozen without execution
transfer and limitation prose compressed while preserving nulls and page budget
current_external_verdict_authority: Stanford round-2 historical verdict remains Weak Accept; R12 has not been externally rescored.
